note: Magic numbers hardcoded directly inside cell formulas (not named ranges), documented from reading the Blind Quote / Curtain Quote row formulas. Other product families' own literals should be confirmed the same way when their formula chains are ported during pricing-engine build -- this list is not exhaustive across all 40+ price groups, only the two central formula chains analysed so far.

blind_sell_markup_factor.found_in: Blind Quote!AR3 (and AW3 Panel track price)
blind_sell_markup_factor.meaning: Multiplier applied to the raw Blind_Pricing grid lookup to get sell price.

blind_freight_flat_fee.meaning: Flat freight charge added per blind line, when a price was found (AR3>0).

curtain_fabric_waste_factor.meaning: 3% extra fabric allowance applied to the raw metreage calculation.

curtain_fullness_base_percent.meaning: Base fullness percentage divisor before over/sheer/lining adjustments.

curtain_over_sheer_fullness_adjustment.meaning: Added to the fullness base when curtain is Over 270cm AND (Sheer OR Twin/Inverted Lining OH).

curtain_twin_inverted_oh_fullness_adjust.meaning: Subtracted from the fullness base for Twin Lining OH / Inverted Lining OH styles.

curtain_making_cost_markup_addend.meaning: Added to the hooks/fullness-derived percentage (AN3) before dividing by 100 to scale the making price.

curtain_sheer_over_making_multiplier.meaning: Multiplier applied to curtain-making cost when (Sheer OR Inverted/Twin Lining OH) AND Over 270cm.

curtain_lining_cost_per_metre.meaning: Lining cost per metre of drop (AS3), doubled again if the curtain is Extra Wide.

curtain_installation_tier_threshold_mm.meaning: Below this track length (Y3, mm) installation is tiered; at/above it a flat $250 applies.

curtain_installation_flat_over_threshold.meaning: Flat installation charge once track length reaches curtain_installation_tier_threshold_mm.

curtain_installation_tier_step_mm.meaning: Track-length step size (mm) used to add extra half-installation-cost increments below the flat threshold.

curtain_installation_tier_base_mm.meaning: Base track length (mm) the tiering offset is measured from.

curtain_over_length_threshold_mm.meaning: Drop length (cm, note: compare units when implementing) above which the 'Over' surcharge path applies.
